name: MPU-6050 six-axis motion sensor
description: InvenSense MPU-6050 accelerometer and gyroscope on I2C (0x68/0x69 from AD0): asleep after power-on, the sample rate from SMPLRT_DIV and the digital low-pass filter, four full-scale ranges for each sensor, the die temperature and the data-ready interrupt. Acceleration (g), rotation rate (deg/s) and temperature are interactive inputs.

functional.claims: I2C at 0x68 + AD0 with auto-incrementing reads and writes; WHO_AM_I 0x68; power-on and DEVICE_RESET to sleep with registers cleared; the sample rate from SMPLRT_DIV and the DLPF, each sample the inputs as they were the DLPF's delay earlier; the four accelerometer and gyroscope full-scale ranges with saturation at the 16-bit limits; the temperature at 340 LSB/C from 36.53 C; burst reads from one sampling instant; standby axes and TEMP_DIS frozen; DATA_RDY in INT_STATUS and on INT (50 us pulse or latched, level and open-drain options); no answer below 2.375 V.
omissions: the auxiliary I2C master and pass-through (XDA, XCL)
sensor noise, offsets and their drift with temperature (readings exact to the LSB)
the start-up settling (30 ms for the gyroscope)
